name: getUsage
description: Read MCP tool calls used, included, remaining, and the weekly reset time. This status check does not consume usage.

name: listDesigns
description: Start here. List the signed-in user’s structured Loora designs and canonical editor URLs.

name: getDesignContext
description: Read the target, revision, responsive settings, tokens, Pages, components, and a compact tree in one call. Use this before editing.

name: readTree
description: Read a compact semantic Canvas tree. Use NodeRefs from this result for precise edits.

name: readNode
description: Read one complete structured source node and an optional instance override.

name: searchNodes
description: Search node names and text content in a structured design.

name: createPage
description: Create an editable responsive Page with typed local state and nested structured nodes in one engine transaction. Event interactions can set, toggle, or increment state, switch any named visual theme, and react through conditional state-change rules. Model normal Tailwind layouts with flex/grid, gap, padding, fill, and hug; use absolute positioning only intentionally.

name: insertNodes
description: Insert nested structured nodes through the Canvas engine. Think in Tailwind layout terms, then express them as validated layout/style fields. Temporary refs are mapped to permanent ids; source code is export-only.

name: patchNodes
description: Patch structured layout, visual, text, responsive, variant, typed Page/component state, and declarative event interaction fields atomically through the Canvas engine. Events may switch any named visual theme; runtime state and the selected runtime theme stay ephemeral.

name: moveNodes
description: Move or reorder source nodes atomically.

name: deleteNodes
description: Delete source nodes and descendants. Set confirmed only after the user approves this destructive action.

name: createComponent
description: Create an off-canvas reusable component definition with optional instance-local typed state and declarative event interactions, including scoped named-theme switching.

name: createInstance
description: Create an instance of an existing component.

name: setTokens
description: Create or update named visual themes and structured design tokens (up to 100 themes and 1,000 tokens per call), and set the persisted default theme. Put per-theme token values in modes keyed by theme id; pass activeThemeId to choose the theme Main or this branch renders with by default — no runtime event needed. set-theme event actions can still switch themes at runtime.

activeThemeId.description: Persisted default theme id the design renders with, e.g. "dark". The theme must exist (define it in themes first, the same call is fine). Read current themes and activeThemeId from getDesignContext.

name: setAnimations
description: Define named motion the design can reuse: pass preset names for the common ones (fade-in, fade-in-up, scale-in, slide-in-left, slide-in-right, pulse, float, spin) or full keyframe definitions, and remove ones no longer used. Point nodes at them with animateNodes.

name: animateNodes
description: Give nodes motion. `hover` takes a preset (lift, grow, shrink, fade, nudge-right) or an explicit style and transform, and brings its own transition; `play` attaches animations defined by setAnimations, with a trigger of load, in-view, always, hover or press. `stagger` spaces a list out so it arrives one item at a time. Pass clear: true to take all motion off.

name: exportCode
description: Generate implementation-ready code for one Page or node. Tailwind returns readable JSX with literal utilities; HTML and JSX are also available. Export is one-way—continue editing through structured Canvas tools.

name: getScreenshot
description: Render a real PNG of one Page or NodeRef with the same DOM/CSS export engine. Call this after meaningful edits to verify the visual result.

name: viewNode
description: Return a canonical open-in-Loora URL and semantic details for one node. Use getScreenshot when image pixels are needed.

name: viewPage
description: Return a canonical open-in-Loora URL and semantic tree for one Page. Use getScreenshot when image pixels are needed.

name: viewCanvas
description: Return a canonical open-in-Loora URL and Page summary. Use getScreenshot to inspect pixels.

name: createDesign
description: Create a new empty Canvas design.

name: renameDesign
description: Rename a design.

name: deleteDesign
description: Permanently delete a design after explicit confirmation.

name: listBranches
description: List branches. Branch state is separate from the canvas package.

name: createBranch
description: Create an isolated app-level branch from current Main.

name: proposeBranch
description: Freeze an active branch for review.

name: reopenBranch
description: Return a proposed branch to editable status.

name: compareBranch
description: Compare a branch with Main using field-level semantic merge.

name: applyBranch
description: Apply a branch to Main. Supply a main or draft choice for every reported conflict.

name: closeBranch
description: Close an active or proposed branch without applying it.

name: listVersions
description: List version history for Main or one branch.

name: listAssets
description: List the signed-in user’s uploaded image assets.
